moves.name: Charm
moves.description: Lowers the target’s Attack by 2 stat ranks.

moves.name: Suits You Well!
moves.description: Raises the user’s Sp. Atk by 2 stat ranks. Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by 1 stat rank. Applies the Gradual Healing effect to the user.

moves.name: Beautiful Blossoms Fairy Beam
moves.description: The more the target’s Attack is lowered, the greater the power of this attack.

passives.name: Use Status P-Move: Stat ↑ 9
passives.description: Has a chance (100%) of raising one of the user’s following stats by 1 stat rank at random when its Pokémon uses a status move: Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed, accuracy, or evasiveness.

passives.name: Quick Tempo
passives.description: Applies the Move Gauge Acceleration effect to the allied field of play the first time the user enters a battle each battle.

passives.name: Mutually Assured
passives.description: Whenever an opponent leaves the user poisoned, badly poisoned, paralyzed, or burned, the same status condition is also applied to that opponent.
